```yaml
name: Build .deb Packages

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
    branches:
      - master
      - main
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/build_deb.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-deb:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    strategy:
      matrix:
        variant: [basic, hardsubx]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Free disk space
        uses: jlumbroso/free-disk-space@main
        with:
          android: true
          dotnet: true
          haskell: true
          large-packages: true
          docker-images: true
          preinstalled-runtimes: true
          tool-cache: true
          swap-storage: true

      - name: Cache APT packages
        uses: awalsh128/cache-apt-pkgs-action@latest
        with:
          packages: build-essential cmake pkg-config libssl-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev libxml2-dev libx264-dev libx265-dev libnuma-dev libbz2-dev liblzma-dev libzstd-dev libfontconfig1-dev libfreetype6-dev libpng-dev libjpeg-dev libtiff-dev libwebp-dev libopenjp2-7-dev libavcodec-dev libavformat-dev libavutil-dev libswscale-dev libavfilter-dev libavdevice-dev libass-dev libfribidi-dev libharfbuzz-dev libtheora-dev libvorbis-dev libvpx-dev libopus-dev libmp3lame-dev libfdk-aac-dev libxvidcore-dev patchelf dpkg-dev debhelper
          version: 1.0

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            build-essential \
            cmake \
            pkg-config \
            libssl-dev \
            libcurl4-openssl-dev \
            libxml2-dev \
            libx264-dev \
            libx265-dev \
            libnuma-dev \
            libbz2-dev \
            liblzma-dev \
            libzstd-dev \
            libfontconfig1-dev \
            libfreetype6-dev \
            libpng-dev \
            libjpeg-dev \
            libtiff-dev \
            libwebp-dev \
            libopenjp2-7-dev \
            libavcodec-dev \
            libavformat-dev \
            libavutil-dev \
            libswscale-dev \
            libavfilter-dev \
            libavdevice-dev \
            libass-dev \
            libfribidi-dev \
            libharfbuzz-dev \
            libtheora-dev \
            libvorbis-dev \
            libvpx-dev \
            libopus-dev \
            libmp3lame-dev \
            libfdk-aac-dev \
            libxvidcore-dev \
            patchelf \
            dpkg-dev \
            debhelper \
            git

      - name: Build GPAC from source
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 --branch abi-16.4 https://github.com/gpac/gpac.git gpac-src
          cd gpac-src
          ./configure --static-bin --disable-x11 --disable-x11-shared --disable-x11-gui --disable-x11-gui-shared --disable-x11-gui-static
          make -j$(nproc)
          sudo make install
          cd ..

      - name: Build CCExtractor
        run: |
          mkdir -p build
          cd build
          cmake .. \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
            -DENABLE_OCR=${{ matrix.variant == 'basic' && 'ON' || 'OFF' }} \
            -DENABLE_FFMPEG=${{ matrix.variant == 'hardsubx' && 'ON' || 'OFF' }}
          make -j$(nproc)

      - name: Create Debian Package Structure
        run: |
          PKG_NAME="ccextractor"
          PKG_VERSION=$(grep -oP 'set\(CCEXTRACTOR_VERSION "\K[^"]+' CMakeLists.txt)
          PKG_VARIANT="${{ matrix.variant }}"
          PKG_DIR="${PKG_NAME}_${PKG_VERSION}_${PKG_VARIANT}_amd64"
          
          mkdir -p ${PKG_DIR}/DEBIAN
          mkdir -p ${PKG_DIR}/usr/bin
          mkdir -p ${PKG_DIR}/usr/lib/ccextractor
          
          # Copy binary
          cp build/ccextractor ${PKG_DIR}/usr/bin/
          
          # Copy GPAC library if needed (bundled)
          if [ -f /usr/local/lib/libgpac.so* ]; then
            cp /usr/local/lib/libgpac.so* ${PKG_DIR}/usr/lib/ccextractor/
            # Set rpath to use bundled library
            patchelf --set-rpath '$ORIGIN/../lib/ccextractor' ${PKG_DIR}/usr/bin/ccextractor
          fi

          # Create control file
          cat > ${PKG_DIR}/DEBIAN/control << EOF
          Package: ${PKG_NAME}
          Version: ${PKG_VERSION}
          Section: video
          Priority: optional
          Architecture: amd64
          Depends: libc6 (>= 2.17), libstdc++6 (>= 6)
          Maintainer: CCExtractor Team <ccextractor@googlegroups.com>
          Description: Closed Caption Extractor (${PKG_VARIANT})
           Extracts closed captions from video files.
           This is the ${PKG_VARIANT} variant.
          EOF

          # Create postinst
          cat > ${PKG_DIR}/DEBIAN/postinst << 'EOF'
          #!/bin/sh
          set -e
          if [ "$1" = "configure" ]; then
            ldconfig
          fi
          EOF
          chmod 755 ${PKG_DIR}/DEBIAN/postinst

          # Create postrm
          cat > ${PKG_DIR}/DEBIAN/postrm << 'EOF'
          #!/bin/sh
          set -e
          if [ "$1" = "remove" ]; then
            ldconfig
          fi
          EOF
          chmod 755 ${PKG_DIR}/DEBIAN/postrm

          # Build the package
          dpkg-deb --build ${PKG_DIR}

      - name: Upload Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ccextractor-${{ matrix.variant }}-deb
          path: ccextractor*_amd64.deb

      - name: Attach to Release
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          files: ccextractor*_amd64.deb
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
